subject.title: fix: Slack drops attachments delivered via message_changed file_share events

question: Must an affected-workspace redacted initial/final payload pair be supplied before accepting this content-version dedupe contract?
rationale: The code path and tests are strong, but neither official event-shape documentation nor the two live probes establishes that Slack emits the exact sequence the patch is designed to handle.

options.title: Require the affected trace
options.body: Keep the PR open until a redacted initial/final event pair demonstrates the sequence and the exact head processes finalization once while suppressing replay.

options.title: Approve a proof override
options.body: Accept the implementation based on source plausibility and synthetic coverage while explicitly owning the remaining risk that the real payload shape differs.
